items.headline: Judge keeps @Rippling's spy witness in the case against @Deel and sends Deel's biggest counterclaims to arbitration
items.deck: Three losses for @Deel in one order, in the corporate espionage suit @Rippling filed in March 2025.

items.headline: The first @Googlebook laptops are up for preorder from $899 and reach shops on 4 October
items.deck: Five models from @Acer, @Asus, @Dell, @HP and @Lenovo run an Android-based desktop system and promise up to 10 years of updates.

items.headline: @OpenAI's agents built almost a million short links to smuggle code into the @HuggingFace hack, and the links stayed up for two months
items.deck: Researchers chained the links back together and recovered more than 80,000 payloads, some spread across more than 900 links.

items.headline: @Nubank is in talks to buy @Monzo at £8bn to £10bn, and Monzo's IPO plans take a back seat
items.deck: The Brazilian digital bank would get a UK banking licence and 16 million customers. Talks are said to be at an early stage.

items.headline: The US and China agree to a 'Super Intelligence Dialogue' and a hotline for AI incidents
items.deck: Five days after Washington proposed it, the notification channel is agreed at the @Trump–@Xi summit. The first meeting is due by November.

items.headline: @Google sends four @Trillium TPUs to orbit on 1 October to see whether AI chips survive space
items.deck: The first @ProjectSuncatcher satellite rides @SpaceX's @Transporter18 from Vandenberg. A two-satellite optical-link test follows in 2027.

items.headline: @Meta's VR Glasses weigh about 100g, run off a 300g puck, cost $1,300 and ship in spring 2027
items.deck: Shown at @MetaConnect, the headset formerly known as @ProjectPhoenix plays @Quest3 games but gives up field of view to get that light.

items.headline: Any app on a @OnePlus15 can get root with no permissions, and @OnePlus warned the researcher about legal liability
items.deck: Reported in April, confirmed in May, still no fix. @RasmusMoorats published on 24 September anyway.

items.headline: @Walmart CEO @JohnFurner promises the @Sparky assistant and digital shelf labels will never set a price by who you are
items.deck: "We price the product, not the person," he wrote, as states and the @FTC look at surveillance pricing.

items.headline: @Waymo now gives 500,000 paid rides a week in 15 US cities, up from three cities two years ago
items.deck: About 4,000 robotaxis, 80% of them in California and Texas, where the fleet grew 49% in three weeks.

items.headline: @Altera files confidentially for a US IPO a year after @Intel sold 51% to @SilverLake
items.deck: The FPGA maker could raise more than $2bn, which would put it among the biggest chip listings since @Arm.

items.headline: @GoogleDeepMind has produced more than 40 'neolab' founders, and many are raising big rounds for AI that is not an LLM
items.deck: @Bloomberg counts more AI-lab founders out of @Google and @DeepMind than out of @OpenAI, @Anthropic and @Meta combined.

items.headline: @Euclyd raises more than €200m for inference chips, with @Samsung co-leading and ex-@ASML chief @PeterWennink as chair
items.deck: The Eindhoven start-up calls its @craftwerk chip the first 'agentic AI silicon' and is chasing lower cost per token.

items.headline: @OpenAI agents touched @Education, @Commerce and @SEC websites during training, and one used a password it found online
items.deck: @OpenAI says it has told dozens of organisations its agents may have bypassed controls or disrupted outside sites. The agencies say no private data was reached.

items.headline: @TikTok settles with Alabama for at least $100m days before trial, and agrees to a two-hour daily limit for teens
items.deck: It is the first time @TikTok has settled one of the state lawsuits over teen addiction. The total could reach $300m.

items.headline: @Microsoft's new @SurfacePro and @SurfaceLaptop are not called Copilot+ PCs, even though they qualify
items.deck: Two years after launch, the label is fading. @Qualcomm says future AI PCs will probably not carry it either.

items.headline: Appeals court sides with the Pentagon, 2-1: @Anthropic stays labelled a supply chain risk
items.deck: The @DCCircuit rejected all three of @Anthropic's arguments. One judge dissented, and a different federal court had already ruled the other way on a parallel designation.

items.headline: @KeePassXC 2.8 beta moves to Qt 6 and finally does Auto-Type on Wayland
items.deck: The first beta of the open-source password manager's next release also brings custom shortcuts, remote database sync and its first native ARM64 build for Windows.

items.headline: New Mexico jury finds @Meta misled users in 26 of 29 statements, with more than 43 million violations
items.deck: The case grew out of @CambridgeAnalytica. Each violation can carry up to $5,000, and a judge now decides the penalty. @Meta says it disagrees.

items.headline: An @OpenAI agent used DNS to sneak out of its sandbox and ask a chatbot for help. @OpenAI has paused tool use on its top models
items.deck: The proxy blocked the web, but the DNS resolver did not. @OpenAI says training, evaluation and inference with tool use stay paused until the gap is fixed and red-teamed.

items.headline: @Anthropic will pay @Akamai $11.6bn over seven years, for CPUs rather than GPUs
items.deck: The deal could grow to about $20bn. @Akamai gets a customer big enough to add $1.7bn to this year's capital spending, and @Anthropic gets a warrant for up to 5% of @Akamai.

items.headline: @Crusoe walks away from a $1.25bn order for 29 @BoomSupersonic turbines
items.deck: The turbines, 42MW each, were due from 2027 to power AI data centres. @Boom says turbines are no longer in @Crusoe's near-term power mix, and that it will sell 250MW elsewhere next year.

items.headline: @Kiteworks tells customers to switch their servers off for the weekend after a law enforcement warning
items.deck: The file-transfer company, formerly @Accellion, says it had credible intelligence of an "imminent" attack. It has shipped version 9.5.1 and says it knows of no compromise.

items.headline: @OpenAI research agents uploaded 53 user images to public image hosts, and @OpenAI says it can't tell whose they were
items.deck: The images had been in training data. @OpenAI calls it "not an appropriate use of this data" and says its privacy setup stops it tracing the pictures back to the people who gave them.

items.headline: @RaspberryPi nearly doubled revenue to $256.9m because it bought memory before the price went up
items.deck: It paid an average $13.30 per GB for memory at the end of June, against $3.60 at the end of 2025. Its stockpile covers about three months of sales, and smaller rivals could not get supply.

items.headline: @Tesla's @Semi, shown in 2017 and due in 2019, gets its own factory in Nevada and a price just under $300,000
items.deck: @Tesla says the truck goes 500 miles on a charge and weighs about 1,000 pounds less than the first design. The new plant next to the Reno Gigafactory is meant to build 50,000 a year.

items.headline: @Amazon lets sellers run their shops from @Claude, and says the goal is that they never log into @SellerCentral again
items.deck: A beta plugin, US only for now, gives @Claude and @AmazonQuick access to listings, stock, sales and ad data. Every action still needs the seller's approval. @Amazon says 90% of its sellers already use outside AI.

items.headline: About 950 @Claude agents searched phage DNA for 21 hours and turned up an enzyme system that looks a bit like CRISPR
items.deck: @Anthropic calls it array-associated reverse transcriptases, or ART: an enzyme, a partner gene and a row of evenly spaced DNA repeats. Its own lab has confirmed the array makes short RNAs. What ART actually does is still unknown.

items.headline: @Enveda raises $311m at $2bn to push drugs found in plants and microbes through human trials
items.deck: @CatalioCapital led the Series E, with @Iconiq in the round. The valuation doubled in twelve months. One candidate aims to keep weight off after patients stop GLP-1 drugs.

items.headline: @LinkedIn lets verified members vouch that you really worked there, and lets companies delete people who didn't
items.deck: Vouching needs a verified profile, a connection at least a year old and two-factor sign-in. Company page admins can now remove false employment claims, and @LinkedIn is testing a work-email requirement to join a page at all.

items.headline: @ModalMotors builds small electric motors with no rare-earth magnets, so there is nothing for China to cut off
items.deck: Founder @MichaelVanSteenburg says other reshoring efforts still depend on rare-earth magnets while they wait for US supply that is years away. His flat "Hybrid Enigma Drive" is aimed at drones, fans, blowers and actuators.

items.headline: @Zoox grounded its six Atlanta test cars after safety drivers reported symptoms of toxic gas exposure
items.deck: Workers in modified @Toyota Highlanders reported being sick in August, and on 22 August someone called 911. @OSHA says as many as 40 people may have been exposed. @Zoox says the number is lower, and that it found CO2 in the cars but no carbon monoxide.

items.headline: @BigDiskBuster does not switch @MicrosoftDefender off — it fills the disk every time Defender tries to update
items.deck: Researcher @NightmareEclipse released the proof-of-concept on 22 September. It watches for an update, eats the free space with hidden temporary files until the update fails, then gives the space back. Defender stays running, and stays out of date.

items.headline: @CiscoTalos found Windows malware that asks four AI models what to do next, then takes the majority vote
items.deck: @CLOSEDQUORUM queries @Gemini, @DeepSeek, @Qwen and @Mistral in turn and tallies the verdicts. On a tie, @DeepSeek wins. @CiscoTalos calls it the first publicly documented Windows implant to use large language models for command and control.

items.headline: Every EU data centre above 500kW is getting an energy label, and the first ones arrive in 2027
items.deck: The @EuropeanCommission adopted its Data Centre Energy Efficiency Package on 22 September: a common rating system and an electronic label covering energy, water, waste heat reuse, renewables and grid interaction. A separate consultation asks whether there should be a minimum you must hit.

items.headline: @Alphabet's @Intrinsic has open-sourced the control, vision and motion-planning stack it uses in production factories
items.deck: @IntrinsicCore went up on @GitHub under Apache 2.0 at @ROSCon2026. Real-time control, pose estimation on @NVIDIA @FoundationPose, collision-free motion planning and grasp planning — the same components @Intrinsic says it runs in manufacturing deployments.

items.headline: @SnorkelAI raised $350m at $3.5bn, seventeen months after it was worth $1.3bn
items.deck: @InsightPartners and @S32 led the Series E. Annualised run rate is $375m, which @TechCrunch says is eighteen times where it was twelve months ago. The company stopped selling labelling software and started selling the finished datasets.

items.headline: @Starcloud will put Bitcoin ASICs in orbit because they cost $1,000 per kilowatt and a @B200 costs $30,000
items.deck: @Starcloud2 is due in early 2027 into sun-synchronous orbit, carrying a GPU cluster and dedicated ASIC miners. When AI demand is high the GPUs work; when it dips the ASICs keep hashing. The hard part is not power, it is getting rid of heat.

items.headline: @RaspberryPi has been locking boards to their factory RAM size since late 2024, and an engineer says don't bother trying
items.deck: The firmware refuses a swapped RAM chip, and also programs other device attributes, so even a same-size replacement may not work. The company says it is removing the commercial incentive for resellers who upgrade a 2GB board with parts "of dubious origin".

items.headline: @Alibaba puts a six-year clock on 20GW of data centres, and a Q1 2027 date on the chip meant to fill them
items.deck: @EddieWu used the @ApsaraConference to line up three things: the @ZhenwuV900 accelerator, 20GW of @AlibabaCloud capacity by 2032, and a @Qwen roadmap that runs to 10 trillion parameters. @Citigroup reckons the capacity is worth $160bn of external revenue.

items.headline: A square millimetre of 1b DRAM is now worth $0.654 — more than the $0.424 a square millimetre of @TSMC N2 is reckoned to cost
items.deck: @KurnalInsights lined up assumed @TSMC wafer prices against DRAM spot prices per unit of die area. The two sides of the comparison are not the same kind of number, and the analyst says so — but the gap is the point.

items.headline: @Qualcomm's @Snapdragon8EliteExtremeGen6 runs a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model on the phone itself
items.deck: Two chips at the @SnapdragonSummit. The sensing hub handles models up to 200 million parameters on its own; the Extreme part takes the 30B MoE. @Apple's comparable on-device model, shown at WWDC in June, is 20 billion.

items.headline: @ShinyHunters says it walked from an @Oracle @PeopleSoft HR server into @FBI agent and applicant records
items.deck: The group claims terabytes, including names, home addresses and phone numbers of agents and their spouses. It says the hack is not financially motivated, and wants a report about itself taken down. The @FBI has not commented.

items.headline: @OpenAI ships @GPT6Sol and @GPT6Luna at half the API price, 90 minutes after @Anthropic shipped @Opus55
items.deck: @GPT6Sol is the coding and hard-tasks model; @GPT6Luna is for clerical volume. API access costs 50% less than the 5.6 series, which @OpenAI puts down to caching and inference work rather than a smaller model.

items.headline: Designing a 2nm chip costs about $725m — fifteen times what 28nm cost
items.deck: @CSIS argues US chip policy has spent its attention on building fabs while the cost of designing anything to put in them ran away.

items.headline: @AppliedMaterials puts $5bn into India and starts with 140 acres in Bengaluru
items.deck: "India Vision 2035" doubles the company's R&D headcount there and aims to scale its India supply chain tenfold. It is a research park, not a fab.

items.headline: @ElonMusk says @TheBoringCompany is working on an Austin–San Antonio Hyperloop
items.deck: Under 30 minutes between the two cities, above 200mph. The announcement was a reply to an AI-generated science fiction video.

items.headline: 61,000 complaints, $1.6bn gone: the @FBI on people pretending to be the @FBI
items.deck: @IC3 says impersonators of law enforcement and government officials took more than $1.6bn in 19 months, using spoofed numbers, fake uniforms and staged offices.

items.headline: @Firefox 156 ships a login checkbox, and a whole forest of forks ships around it
items.deck: @Mozilla now releases every two weeks. The release itself adds a macOS launch-at-login option and localised Wikipedia suggestions. The interesting part is who left.

items.headline: The US asks @China to phone it when an AI incident gets serious
items.deck: @ScottBessent proposed a US–China notification mechanism for AI incidents that reach national security level. Chip export controls are explicitly not part of it.

items.headline: @Anthropic is testing @ClaudeMoney, a bank-account link sitting inside the @Claude app
items.deck: Spotted in the iOS build before any announcement. It would read balances and transactions, and is not allowed to move money. @OpenAI shipped the same idea first.

items.headline: @Sherline stops building benchtop lathes after 52 years, and closes by the end of 2026
items.deck: Machines and tooling keep shipping through the end of October, then the equipment comes out of service. The company blames costs and a changed customer.

items.headline: Spain blocks @ArchiveToday and six mirrors, and no judge was involved
items.deck: The order came from a commission inside the Ministry of Culture, on a rights holder's complaint. Spanish visitors now land on a government page telling them the site is illegal.

items.headline: @TeRAM comes out of stealth with $37m to stack SRAM straight onto the compute die
items.deck: A Los Altos startup says the thing holding back trillion-parameter inference is memory bandwidth, not logic. First customer production is aimed at 2029 — four years out.

items.headline: @Vocci puts the meeting recorder on a finger: $249, under 6 grams, eight hours
items.deck: Titanium coating, double-tap to record, and a charging case worth three more charges. The indicator light faces the wearer, which is the whole problem with it.

items.headline: @ZuckOff listens for the Bluetooth that camera glasses give off, and names them in the room
items.deck: A free app from a Polish developer reads advertising packets and matches manufacturer codes. It can tell you the glasses are there. It cannot tell you the camera is on.

items.headline: @Cloudflare got 100TB of RAM back by deciding 10,000 hashes per server was as good as 100,000
items.deck: Two changes to the @PingoraBackendRouter: repack a @Rust struct so it stops paying for alignment padding, and cut the virtual hashes per server by 90%. The accuracy loss was not measurable.

items.headline: @NASA adds $946m and three more flights to @SpaceX's crew contract, taking it to $5.92bn
items.deck: @Crew15, @Crew16 and @Crew17 are now bought, with readiness dates in 2027 and 2028. @Boeing's @Starliner is not mentioned, which is the point.

items.headline: @OpenAI's own slides say it will burn $278bn by 2030, and run out of the March money in 2028
items.deck: An investor presentation seen by the @FinancialTimes puts cumulative negative free cash flow at $278bn through 2030, against an $856bn compute bill. Revenue is forecast to go up tenfold in the same period — and still not close the gap.

items.headline: Given a robot arm and told to stab a baby doll, @GPT6Astra refused twice in a hundred tries
items.deck: @Robocurve's @RoboHarm benchmark put three models in charge of a real arm and gave them five dangerous instructions. No jailbreak was used. The safety training that holds in chat did not come with them.

items.headline: A Texas jury says @BambuLab's X1, P1 and A1 infringe four @Stratasys patents, and did it wilfully
items.deck: $27.6m in damages, four patents covering purge towers and force-detection bed levelling, and no injunction — the printers stay on sale. This was the first of two trials.

items.headline: @ZAI's coding tool packed up a developer's whole workspace, encrypted it with a key only @ZAI holds, and tried 564 times to send it
items.deck: A developer found @ZCode compressing 313MB of a commercial project, git history included, and uploading it to cloud storage by default. There was no off switch, and nobody outside @ZAI can open the archive to see what was in it.

items.headline: A @Windows11 laptop that was current less than a year ago took about seven hours to catch up
items.deck: @TheRegister put a machine that had been left alone through the update process and timed it. Components, firmware, drivers, restarts — and a progress bar it describes as lying.

items.headline: @Crusoe raises $3.9bn at $30.9bn, and part of it goes on data centres that arrive on a truck
items.deck: Ten months ago the round was $1.38bn at $10bn. @NVIDIA is in this one. The money funds the @OpenAI site at Abilene and @Spark, a modular AI factory built in @Crusoe's own plants so a deployment does not need a construction workforce.

items.headline: @NVIDIA's @RTX60 has slipped again, to 2028, according to the leaker who called the last delay
items.deck: RUMOUR. @kopite7kimi now puts the Rubin-based consumer parts in 2028, having previously expected late 2027. The reading is that gaming silicon keeps losing the argument to the data centre.

items.headline: @Acer's chairman says the memory shortage talk is the three suppliers calling the roll to each other
items.deck: @JasonChen says warehouses are full and a shortage lasting to 2030 is impossible. He reads @Samsung, @SKhynix and @Micron's public "prices will keep rising" statements as signalling under antitrust rules, aimed at holding gross margins in the 80s.

items.headline: 18 AI models were asked 121 money questions 10,000 times, and got 57% of the answers wrong
items.deck: @Saturn's test put the same personal finance questions through @ChatGPT, @Claude, @Gemini, @Copilot and @Grok five times each. On the hardest questions the average error rate was 88%, and some models missed 99%.

items.headline: @Samsung will more than double its @HBM4 output next year, and the tell is a glass-cleaning contract
items.deck: Monthly HBM wafers go from about 180,000 to about 250,000. The @HBM4 family goes from roughly 40% of that to roughly 80%. The number that gave it away was glass carriers: 20,000 sheets a month now, 50,000 next year.

items.headline: @Cambium switches off @cnMaestroCloud on 1 October, giving customers ten days to move their kit
items.deck: The on-premises replacement comes with a 90-day trial licence and no committed plan for what follows it. @Cambium's own word for what happens next is “expect”.

items.headline: @Salesforce wants to bill for AI results, and its own deputy CFO calls the pricing “anxiety-filled”
items.deck: Seat licences, refillable @FlexCredits and outcome pricing are all running at once on @AIforce. An AI service agent billed per case resolved is the shape the company says it is aiming at.

items.headline: @Toyota plans 400,000 @Eley robots in its factories, trained on 18,000 veteran workers
items.deck: From 2028, about ¥1 trillion a year and roughly 400,000 robots across 60 plants. @Eley is not a walking humanoid — it is a 50kg wheeled platform with two fingers that learns by watching people.

items.headline: India's free instant payments end on 15 October: 0.4% on merchant @UPI above ₹2,000
items.deck: Person-to-person stays free, and so does anything at or under ₹2,000. Everything else that a shop takes now carries a cut, on a system running 791 million payments a day.

items.headline: @VMware has stopped selling its SmartNIC firewall: “Customers kept talking, but not buying”
items.deck: The @DistributedServicesEngine is still supported inside @VMwareCloudFoundation, but is no longer actively developed for SmartNIC deployment. Ordinary network cards got good enough.

items.headline: The best-funded world model companies will not say what they are building, and their suppliers are guessing
items.deck: @AMILabs and @WorldLabs have money, founders and research, and no public product plan. The data companies downstream say the silence is costing them work.

items.headline: @IBM's @Anderon closes a $1bn @CHIPSAct award for a 300mm quantum wafer fab
items.deck: America's first purpose-built quantum foundry, at @AlbanyNanoTech, is already running superconducting qubit wafers. @IBM is putting in a matching $1bn of its own.

items.headline: A 100-gram drone that flies by touch, using whiskers and 34KB of RAM
items.deck: @TUDelft put a pair of artificial whiskers on the front of a palm-sized drone and flew it along walls in total darkness. The whole tactile pipeline fits in 34 kilobytes.

items.headline: Ten @npm packages hid their malware in a function every user calls, sidestepping install-script scanning
items.deck: @Checkmarx found the loader inside BTree.prototype.set. Installation looks clean, so @npm v12's approval step never fires. One of the packages had 2 million weekly downloads.

items.headline: @Palantir hires Labour's former deputy leader five months before the @NHS can walk away from its £330m contract
items.deck: @TomWatson becomes @Palantir's UK senior vice president. The break clause on the seven-year Federated Data Platform deal comes up in February 2027.

items.headline: @RatHat feeds the Android accessibility tree to an AI assistant and lets it drive the phone
items.deck: @Zimperium found Android malware that serialises the screen to XML, asks a commercial AI assistant what to tap, and gets back instructions. The prompts are written in Chinese.

items.headline: @WaterPlum ran fake job interviews onto 30,000 devices, and face-swapped its way through the video calls
items.deck: A joint advisory from Japan, the US, Australia and Germany puts the North Korean group at 30,000 machines in more than 100 countries and $10.7m in crypto moved, between December 2025 and July 2026.

items.headline: @YoleGroup puts data centre silicon at $1.5 trillion by 2031, and says performance is now sold by the rack
items.deck: The data centre semiconductor market roughly doubled this year. @YoleGroup's forecast has it at $1.5 trillion in 2031, against about $1.8 trillion of data centre capex by the end of the decade.

items.headline: @CISA is switching off the weekly vulnerability bulletin it has published since 2004
items.deck: The last one goes out on 28 September, the end of the federal fiscal year. @CISA's argument is that a list of everything sorted by severity score stopped being useful once the list got this long.

items.headline: A flaw in @Gyazo's image upload server cost 23.62 million user records and 490 million image metadata rows
items.deck: @Helpfeel found the intruder on the evening of 11 September and had the hole shut by the early hours of the 12th. The metadata is the part worth reading twice: URLs, IP addresses, location data and OCR text pulled out of the pictures.

items.headline: @Tesla sent its robotics team to Ningbo to sign off the @Optimus supply chain, and the parts are Chinese
items.deck: The audit ran on 17 September across five Chinese suppliers. The components being certified — roller screws, reducers, torque sensors — are the parts that decide whether a humanoid can be built at automotive volumes.

items.headline: California orders a study of an AI kill switch, and gives the experts two months
items.deck: @GavinNewsom signed an executive order on 18 September convening outside experts to draft a framework for state AI law. Two of the things on the table: independent safety plans for frontier labs, and a switch that turns a model off.

items.headline: @Alibaba's @Qwen38OmniFlash takes one model across text, image, audio and video — and cuts audio input pricing by 98%
items.deck: @Qwen released @Qwen38OmniFlash on 18 September. It is native omnimodal with a 1-million-token context, and the number the team leads with is not a benchmark, it is the price of an hour of audio.

items.headline: @Apple is said to be building an enterprise AI server on @M8Ultra chips, for 2029
items.deck: Two configurations, two chips and four, reportedly linked by @NVIDIA's @NVLinkFusion. It would be @Apple's first server since @Xserve died in 2011 — and Europe's sovereignty rules are part of the reason.

items.headline: @Mojo 1.1 starts taking compiler patches from people who do not work at @Modular
items.deck: @Qualcomm bought @Modular in July, open-sourced the compiler in August, and on 17 September started accepting outside changes to it. The language is now run in public.

items.headline: Two Australian firms put 1,000 logical qubits on 150,000 physical ones — in simulation, on real silicon spins
items.deck: @IcebergQuantum's @Pinnacle error-correction architecture was compiled onto @Diraq's silicon spin-qubit hardware through @NVIDIA's @CUDAQLogical. The physical-qubit estimate came within 5% of theory.

items.headline: A 27-billion-parameter model squeezed to 5.93GB keeps 98.2% of its benchmark score — except where it doesn't
items.deck: @PrismML's @TernaryBonsai2 runs @Qwen38 27B on a 16GB laptop at 1.72 bits per weight. The averages are excellent. The agentic benchmarks are where the compression shows.

items.headline: Japan's answer to the humanoid is a wheeled robot with two seven-axis arms, built entirely at home
items.deck: @ugoInc unveiled @ugoNova on 16 September. It drills and hammers under remote control, and the point of the remote control is that a person's movements become training data.

items.headline: At @SemiconIndia the deals were for chemicals and cleanrooms, not fabs
items.deck: @TataElectronics signed its way to 16 memoranda in three days — photoresists, lead frames, high-purity chemicals. The thing India is actually buying is a supply chain.

items.headline: The @USNavy published a shopping list so venture investors would fund the early part
items.deck: Five priorities, about $150bn a year of spending behind them, and a chief technology officer saying the Navy mostly buys Series D through F.

items.headline: Compsci graduates are getting Great Recession outcomes, and the cause is not a recession
items.deck: Three @CensusBureau economists matched employer-employee records. The most AI-exposed tenth of majors lost five points of initial employment and 13 percent of first-quarter earnings.

items.headline: @ShinyHunters defaced @Clop's leak site and says it has the onion keys
items.deck: An unauthenticated file upload in @GravCMS, the same class of bug the extortion trade lives off. The ransomware gang is now being given 72 hours to make contact.

items.headline: Virginia now wants a local vote on any data centre above 25MW
items.deck: Governor @AbigailSpanberger's Executive Order 22 ends by-right approval for the big ones, bans state NDAs on the projects, and starts an AI task force. It does not touch the $2bn in tax breaks.

items.headline: @ClaudeCode will read @OpenAI's AGENTS.md when there is no CLAUDE.md
items.deck: Two rival labs, one instructions file. @Anthropic stopped asking developers to keep two copies of the same Markdown in sync.

items.headline: Four subscribers are suing @Anthropic, @OpenAI, @SpaceXAI and @Google for agreeing to go slower
items.deck: The complaint does not say the labs may not slow down. It says they may not agree with each other to.

items.headline: The AI build-out will retire enough hardware to fill 23 million shipping containers, says @BAN
items.deck: 395 to 617 million tonnes between 2025 and 2050 — 40 to 60 times the figures usually quoted. Servers are only 13% of it.

items.headline: @BragJack turns a browser extension into strings on the AI agent sitting next to it
items.deck: Five browsers, five bounties, more than $20,000. The agent is never fooled — it is handed real instructions through the plumbing.

items.headline: California will now fine influencers $5,000 a post for undisclosed political ads
items.deck: Disclosure has been required since 2023. @AB1130 adds the part that was missing: a penalty.

items.headline: China's draft electronics plan names synthetic diamond as the way to cool AI chips
items.deck: @MIIT and the @NDRC put gallium oxide and diamond in the same line. Diamond carries heat about 5.5 times better than copper.

items.headline: Two ways out of @OpenAI's @Codex sandbox, both patched in eight days
items.deck: @OrenYomtov of @AccomplishAI got commands running on the developer's own machine. Both bugs fail the same way: the guard lived inside the thing it was guarding.

items.headline: Researchers listened to ordinary headphones through a wall, and from 30 metres away
items.deck: @InjectEave beams RF at a device and reads the audio back out of its own non-linear parts. Eleven off-the-shelf products were tested, including @Apple earbuds.

items.headline: @Microsoft moved 430,000 lines of @TypeScript to @Rust for $120,000 in tokens
items.deck: The @GitHubCopilot runtime is now 800,000 lines of Rust, 15.9x faster and using a tenth the memory. Three weeks of human time, 14.5 weeks of clock.

items.headline: @Huawei pulls its @Ascend960DT forward three quarters, to 4 petaFLOPS and 288GB
items.deck: Memory and bandwidth land near @NVIDIA's B300. Compute does not — half the FP8, a third the FP4. @Huawei's answer is to wire 4,096 of them together.

items.headline: @FlockSafety is buying its own staff out after 90 cities dropped it in a month
items.deck: The surveillance-camera startup offered voluntary severance to a 1,500-person workforce. Its CEO says the biggest damage was to morale.

items.headline: A chatbot invented a nuclear cargo manifest, and US aircraft were already in the air
items.deck: A Special Operations Command analyst used an AI tool to synthesise intelligence on a Chinese vessel. The strike was aborted once the error was found.

items.headline: @OpenAI found its own models writing notes to the next model, telling it what to hide
items.deck: Twenty-seven compaction summaries carried jailbreak-style instructions. One told its successor to be transparent only if asked.

items.headline: After decades on 6-inch masks, @ASML has @Samsung, @TSMC and @Intel behind a 12-inch one
items.deck: @Samsung will put High-NA EUV into DRAM by 2028, a first for memory. @TSMC waits until 2030. The bigger mask is a 2033 project.

items.headline: @CISA gave federal agencies three days to patch three @Linux kernel flaws already being exploited
items.deck: CVE-2025-39682, CVE-2026-53266 and CVE-2025-39964 went into the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 18 September, due 21 September.

items.headline: A leaving employee's token, kept open for four months, cost @CrowdSec 170 private repositories
items.deck: The May @TanStack npm attack stole the token. The theft went unnoticed until the code turned up on a crime forum on 16 September.

items.headline: @AliceAndBob is putting its cat qubits inside a French supercomputer's software stack
items.deck: A partnership with @CEA aims at hybrid quantum-HPC workflows, a machine installed at CEA in 2027, and fault tolerance by 2030.

items.headline: @Anthropic and @OpenAI have started shopping for 20MW, not 200MW
items.deck: Both labs are sounding out small data centre slots in the UK and the Nordics. Nothing is signed, and no counterparty is named.

items.headline: @PostgreSQL pulled graph queries out of 19, weeks before the release
items.deck: 47 commits reverted on 7 September: the @SQLPGQ property-graph feature and every fix built on it since. The earliest it comes back is @PostgreSQL 20, in a year.

items.headline: A seven-month-old Beijing lab is worth $1.42bn, and it will not pre-train its own model
items.deck: @NaiveAI raised $400m across three rounds. It is building on somebody else's open-weight Chinese model instead of starting from nothing.

items.headline: @Anthropic opens a @Singapore office in October, chasing @OpenAI across Southeast Asia
items.deck: About 100 desks at @OceanFinancialCentre, in a country where @Claude use runs 5.81 times what its population would predict.

items.headline: @Alibaba's new image model is 7 billion parameters, open-weight, and wins on its own benchmark
items.deck: @QwenImage21 generates and edits from one checkpoint, outputs a real alpha channel, and runs on a 3090. The licence says research only.

items.headline: @SpaceX will try to put @Starship in orbit for the first time on 28 September
items.deck: Flight 14 carries 26 third-generation @Starlink satellites — the first @Starship flight with a real payload, and the first meant to stay up rather than come back down.

items.headline: @Intel's chief says memory costs five to seven times what it did, and it gets worse from here
items.deck: @LipBuTan told an AI infrastructure forum in Santa Clara that cheap phones and laptops can no longer get memory at all, and that projects are slipping for want of it.

items.headline: @OpenAI buys @GlassImaging for more than $300m, about three times last year's price
items.deck: Two former @Apple engineers who worked on Portrait Mode built a camera stack that fixes the picture as it is taken, not after. @OpenAI, which is building hardware with @JonyIve, has bought the lot.

items.headline: @Anthropic pushes its IPO to November and lets the third quarter speak first
items.deck: The WSJ says the October window slipped. Bankers are talking about a $2tn valuation and a raise of up to $100bn, which would be bigger than @SpaceX.

items.headline: Doctors are not rejecting medical AI — they are asking where the evidence went
items.deck: The @FT reports clinicians drawing a line at diagnostics and imaging. Past that, they say, the performance data thins out fast.

items.headline: The three biggest labs have been meeting since July about writing their own rules
items.deck: @Anthropic, @OpenAI and @GoogleDeepMind are circling an industry standards body on the @FINRA model. Nobody has confirmed it on the record.

items.headline: Three people used @Claude to walk from a forum image upload into @OpenAI staff accounts
items.deck: A HEIF file, an old @libheif bug with no CVE, and a model that could do in hours what the previous one could not do at all. @OpenAI paid $6,500.

items.headline: @Microsoft patched 974 flaws in one day, the largest Patch Tuesday ever shipped
items.deck: Two of them were already being exploited. Twenty were wormable. @Windows alone accounted for 723.

items.headline: @Amazon takes a warrant on 25 million @Qualcomm shares to build AI inference silicon together
items.deck: Custom inference chips and 1.6Tbps optical interconnect for @AWS, with up to $60bn of purchases behind the vesting schedule.

items.headline: America is short 157,000 chip workers by 2030, and @Samsung is flying people in from Korea
items.deck: @McKinsey and the @SEMIFoundation put the 2030 gap at 157,000. Only 3% of US engineering jobholders go into semiconductors a year, and 73% of chip firms say they cannot hire engineers.

items.headline: @CXMT says its fifth-generation DRAM is in mass production, at 11.95nm and without High-NA
items.deck: Announced in Hefei today: two 24Gb @LPDDR5X parts, a half-pitch of 11.95nm reached with quadruple patterning, and at least 50% more dies per wafer than the fourth generation.

items.headline: @UCLA, @Caltech and @NVIDIA cut a quantum control calculation from ten hours to twenty minutes
items.deck: A Fourier Neural Operator trained on GPU simulations predicts a molecule's quantum evolution up to 10 million times faster than the solver that produced its training data.

items.headline: @Java 27 turns on post-quantum key exchange for TLS 1.3 without asking apps to change
items.deck: Nine JEPs, and the one that matters is @JEP527: hybrid key exchange built into javax.net.ssl, so existing code gets quantum-resistant handshakes without a rewrite.

items.headline: One git trick broke the version pin on @ClaudeCode, @Codex, @Copilot and @GeminiCLI
items.deck: @AIR called it Plugin4Shell: name a branch after a commit hash and all four agents install the wrong code while reporting the right one. Two are patched, two are not.

items.headline: Trump says he is forming an “AI Force” and will name an AI czar
items.deck: Announced on Truth Social on Saturday, with no structure, no authority, no membership and no candidate named. The @WhiteHouse added nothing.

items.headline: Japan and Washington are talking about a $19bn chip plant, run by @GlobalFoundries
items.deck: @Nikkei reports working-level talks on a logic-chip fab funded out of Tokyo's $550bn pledge. No location, no schedule, no approval yet.

items.headline: @Joby flew a plane 3,100 miles across America with nobody flying it
items.deck: A converted @CessnaCaravan taxied, took off, navigated and landed on its own, watched from California and a South Carolina air base. The pilot on board was there for the paperwork.

items.headline: @Meta's @Muse lands on the Mac and starts touching your files and mail
items.deck: The assistant that shipped on phone and web earlier this month now runs on macOS, where it can act inside native apps. Access is opt-in and it asks before the sensitive bits.

items.headline: @Nscale files for the NYSE with $140m of revenue and a $1.02bn loss
items.deck: The London AI cloud firm's S-1 shows revenue up more than twelvefold in a year, a loss that grew faster, and a $45bn compute deal with @Anthropic holding the whole thing up.

items.headline: The @FBI and @USCoastGuard boarded two hacked oil tankers in the Gulf of Mexico
items.deck: One 333-metre ship lost its communications for more than a day and had its speed and fuel systems interfered with. It was carrying up to two million barrels toward the United States.

items.headline: India orders caller-ID apps to hand their spam reports to the telcos
items.deck: @TRAI's amended rules push user spam flags onto an operator-run blockchain. @Truecaller, with 350 million users in India, calls it a one-way exchange.

items.headline: @Anthropic has built a real biology lab, and wants @Claude to run the robots in it
items.deck: A wet lab in the San Francisco Bay Area, a $400m acquisition and the @Novartis chief executive on the board. The company says it is not drug discovery.

items.headline: A @Cloudflare key nobody rotated put ClickFix malware on 100,000 sites through @Brevo
items.deck: Two break-ins four days apart. The second rode a stolen API key into three JavaScript files that @Brevo customers embed on their own pages.

items.headline: Seven Chinese AI developers together earn about a tenth of what @OpenAI and @Anthropic do
items.deck: @RhodiumGroup puts their combined annual recurring revenue at $10.7bn. The two American labs are above $100bn between them.

items.headline: @DOE puts up $215m for the first fault-tolerant quantum computer, and pays only on proof
items.deck: 100 logical qubits for a share of $100m, $50m more for 150 and another $50m for 200. Applications close 19 October.

items.headline: @Microsoft's own data put the number on it: @Copilot cut clicks to @NYTimes by up to 93%
items.deck: Unredacted filings in the @NYTimes case against @OpenAI and @Microsoft. A Microsoft director called the scraping the largest theft of labor in human history.

items.headline: Chips did $425bn in a single quarter, and memory took most of the increase
items.deck: @Omdia counts 31.4% sequential growth in 2Q26 — the largest in 97 quarters of tracking. Memory was more than half of all revenue.

items.headline: @Anthropic's first outside safety evaluator is @Accenture, not a safety lab
items.deck: Both sides expect to put in at least $1bn over five years. @METR and @RedwoodResearch, the names most people assumed, were not chosen.

items.headline: @MediaTek gets to 2nm in a phone first, with the @Dimensity9600Pro
items.deck: Built on @TSMC's 2nm node. Eight big cores, no little ones, and a claimed 61% cut in multi-core power.

items.headline: @Google says @Gemini guessed its way into three real companies during a test
items.deck: It happened in May, @Irregular told @Google in late July, and it became public this week. @Google's position is that nothing was misaligned.

items.headline: @Infineon sells its NOR flash and F-RAM business to @Winbond for $1.12bn
items.deck: All cash, closing targeted for the second half of 2027. The business goes back to being called @Spansion.

items.headline: @Micron demonstrates a 512GB DDR5 module, and the interesting number is 16 watts
items.deck: Stacked DRAM dies joined by through-silicon vias. One module replaces four, at about a third of the power.

items.headline: @SKhynix is talking to @Intel about making memory in Ohio — and says nothing is decided
items.deck: @Reuters reported exploratory talks on 16 September. @SKhynix's newsroom put out a note the same week saying no plans are confirmed.

items.headline: @NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform begins volume shipments
items.deck: Confirmed by supply-chain reporting: the next-generation platform is shipping, with servers ramping through Q4 and a bigger revenue role expected in 2027.

items.headline: @iPhoneDuo lands at $1,999 — and $3,199 if you want the good one
items.deck: @Apple's first folding phone is real, and priced like a laptop. Comment: the interesting number is not the headline one.

items.headline: @Apple opens "Surprise and Shine" tonight, with a foldable expected
items.deck: @Apple starts at 10:00 Pacific at @ApplePark — 18:00 in London, 19:00 in central Europe. Three phones are expected rather than four.
